newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain insurance sector earns less in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Spain insurance sector earns less in first quarter.

text.p: Spain's insurance sector pre-tax profit declined in the first three months of the year to 55.22 billion pesetas compared with 58.33 billion a year earlier, the General Insurance Association said in a report presented on Monday.
Life and non-life premiums rose to 942.25 billion pesetas compared with 806.19 billion in the first quarter of 1996.
The claims rate compared to premiums acquired dropped to 60.7 percent from 63.08. The ratio of administrative costs to premiums fell to 11.37 percent from 12.08 percent.
